text:
The process itself makes you really not welcome even if you married. 
The job search is also not easy, I actually got asked during interview process if I was Jewish and for big famous tech companies.. it’s illegal but who cares ? Tel Aviv is also more opened but at the same time it’s maybe just more hypocritical than in other regions where they say out loud what they think. I think in general people think the same.
I think on daily life everything is fine but as soon as you face administration or job .. it gets tougher …
